description: Partner accounts only. Change the public page of the partner's own channel. Only the fields you send are written; an empty string clears a text. Overwrites the current values, so confirm the new text with the user first.

accentColor.description: Hex colour such as #7c5cff; must be readable on the dark page.

name.description: Channel name. Cannot change once it is named in a signed agreement.

operatorBio.description: Presentation of the person or team running the channel.

operatorUrl.description: The operator's website, http or https.

picks.description: Selector's picks: up to three article ids from list_channel_releases, in order; [] clears.

name: update_channel

error.description: Present when the call did not succeed.

reason.description: not_a_partner when the signed-in account has no partner account.

title: Update the channel page
